Recap submitted late — arrived 5:56 PM, after the 17:45 grace-period cutoff for Mid.

Sofia D. is so good at her job! She is an excellent example of good communication and I really appreciate how she shows up with a wonderful attitude for the day everyday.  Big shout out to her


I had to have a big convo with Lucy about coach-ability/ communication. I went on a trash run with her and  I brought up to her  how i’d like to see in the future her take a little more initiative in stand.  I explained that she’s been here for long enough that she should feel more confident in her drink making skills as I noticed a lot of standing around and not making drinks today during our big big rushes.  I also spoke to her about communication as this was something I coached her multiple times on today and felt like she wasn’t receptive of.  there was a lot of “yeah,  okay,  thanks greta,” and it seemed like her responses to my coaching were just attitude.  I brought this up to her by showing my perspective on how she responds to my questions and walking her through how it gets interpreted.  I gave her the benefit of the doubt and said i’m sure this isn’t how you meant to come off but when you respond this way it doesn’t seem like you respect what i’m saying.   I feel like our convo was successful and i’m excited to see her implement better communication/ engagement on future shifts
Culture competition: X
Hazard reported: everything works great!

Xbro was a bit of a struggle today. communication from window (lucy) wasn’t great and bars were moving slow.   We were down M1 and pit since the rapid rinsers were broken and I decided it would be more efficient if I just staffed 2 full bars.  I think our biggest problem today was Lucy and Tanya not really being confident on a 2 man bar as there was some wandering/ standing around waiting from both of them.  It was a bigger problem for Lucy however which is why I focused coaching her.  We were really slow on drink making until later in the shift we were able to get the drinks out better.
